sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I1 which must be performed every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The igniter fuel oil 
pumps (2 per unit) supply
oil to the ignitors warm oil burners, flushing pot and
إعادة التدوير line controls the P/P discharge header
press. Under normal operation only one pump is in
service and the other is in stand by usually the stand by pump will stand if
the P/P that is in service trips or if the discharge header press. Drops to the
minimum operational press. Allowed by the ignitors or warm up burners.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

يجب أن يكون موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون فئة السلامة المناسبة
